mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.5% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 9.0%, it signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns when UNRATE < 9.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate robust economic expansion, elevating corporate profit expectations and producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns when HOUST > 550 and GDPC1 growth > 0.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In the low inflation and low interest rate regime (CPIAUCSL < 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), accommodative monetary policy supports equity valuations, generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
regime_hint: low inflation and low interest rate regime
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in the specified regime are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing activity, a leading indicator of economic growth that typically precedes positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in INDPRO growth periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Increasing real personal savings (RSAFS) indicates improved consumer financial health, correlating with higher spending and investment that drives positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in RSAFS growth periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low interest rates (FEDFUNDS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates strong economic fundamentals with accommodative policy, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns through interaction.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE < 9.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
